# A3.07 Design system bootstrap

## Owner
A3

## Stage
Plan

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
CP-02

## Input (reads)
tokens.json and component specs; existing theme file if any

## Steps
1. Check for an existing theme file.
2. Draft the theme file from tokens.
3. Mark it NOT ADOPTED.
4. Request CP-02 through A4.10

## Output (writes)
Draft theme file, marked NOT ADOPTED

## Save path
`frontend/src/theme/ (draft only until CP-02 approved)`

## Verification
File carries NOT ADOPTED until a named approval is recorded

## Checkpoints raised
- none
